title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v6.3 — Session Turn Atomicity, Full Crash Boundary Matrix, Lineage-Independent Face Review, and Provider Lookup Reconciliation
problem: v6.2 established stable request identity and crash-aware replay on a canonical AI-link descendant, but three edges remained. First, stable sequence identity is insufficient if multiple processes can mutate one AI-link session concurrently. Second, distinct face IDs are not necessarily independent reviewers when faces are forks or clones of one lineage. Third, an ambiguous provider outcome needs a structured lookup/reconciliation contract rather than intuition. v6.3 addresses all three and executes the complete declared six-point crash boundary matrix.

protected_span: controlled canonical runtime call or receipt replay
session_turn_atomicity.verified_case: Two separate gateway instances sharing one session store submit concurrent turns and the resulting session contains unique ordered sequences [1,2] with next_sequence=3.
session_turn_atomicity.scope_limit: The lock protects cooperating processes that share the same lock file on a filesystem with working flock semantics. It is not multi-host consensus and does not protect noncooperating writers that bypass the descendant.

lineage_independent_review.novel_counterevidence_rule: Within and across eligible lineages, novel counterevidence is routed ahead of ordinary historical routing priority; a low-score lineage with novel counterevidence can therefore enter the required review set.
lineage_independent_review.red_team_rule: When required, at least one selected independent lineage performs COUNTEREXAMPLE_CHALLENGE if such an independent lineage is available.
lineage_independent_review.insufficient_independence_rule: If the required number of independent lineage roots is unavailable, raise INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_LINEAGES_UNAVAILABLE rather than counting clones as independent reviewers.

structural_checks: observation idempotency_key equals provider binding idempotency_key

outcomes.SETTLED: requires authoritative adapter contract plus receipt_id; retry remains blocked
outcomes.NO_EFFECT: may mark retry safe only under authoritative adapter contract
outcomes.UNKNOWN: remains UNDETERMINED and retry remains blocked
outcomes.NONAUTHORITATIVE: remains UNDETERMINED even if observation text claims NO_EFFECT

provider_lookup_reconciliation.claim_limit: The generic reconciler verifies binding and policy semantics. It does not prove that a real provider adapter is authoritative; that remains provider-specific evidence.

full_declared_crash_matrix.result: no durable runtime event, no canonical world call, retry may execute normally
no world call; live fence blocks immediate competitor/retry; after lease expiry a new generation may proceed
durable pre-call intent exists; no world call; after fence expiry retry may proceed because CALL_ENTERING was never crossed
test knows injected crash occurred before world call, but generic recovery conservatively reports UNDETERMINED because production replay cannot prove that from durable state alone
world call happened; no receipt; retry is UNDETERMINED and does not perform a second world call
durable receipt exists; retry returns cached runtime result without second world call even though old fence was not released

micromanagement_learning.lesson_1: Independent criticism is a lineage property, not a face-count property. Forking one critic into ten faces cannot manufacture ten independent checks.
micromanagement_learning.lesson_2: A low historical routing score may reduce ordinary attention but cannot suppress a genuinely novel counterexample from an independent lineage.
micromanagement_learning.lesson_3: The host should prefer insufficient-review HOLD over counterfeit independence.
micromanagement_learning.lesson_4: Uncertainty must follow durable causal boundaries, not what the test harness privately knows. AFTER_CALL_ENTERING_BEFORE_WORLD is still conservatively UNDETERMINED after restart because the persisted record cannot prove whether the world call occurred.
micromanagement_learning.lesson_5: Provider reconciliation is an external evidence channel. Internal face consensus cannot substitute for it.
